Keywords: As office workers spend a substantial amount of time on working indoors, the indoor environmental quality can
Perceived indoor environmental characteristics significantly affect their mental and work performances. This systematic review provides a synthesis of current
Mental wellbeing studies on the relationship between perceived indoor environmental characteristics (PIEC) and occupants’

effects of visual quality of decoration and environmental maintenance on occupants. Fourth, there is a clear lack
